note: Vessel registry seeds. The live copy is chrome.storage.local:boats — the extension merges these on load, matching by vesselName (case-insensitive) and filling ONLY fields the captain has never answered (mergeSeedBoat). A captain's edit always beats a seed. Anne Bonny's values are verbatim from the 2026-08-06 eNOAD Vessel Details capture (docs/recon/2026-08-06-enoad-tabs/). The fleet's other two boats get entered once on the Boats form.
